43:### Compaction
44-
45-The layered, cheap-first context-shrinking pipeline in `prepare_context`
46-(`code.py`): `tool_result_budget` (persist oversized tool outputs of the
47-latest message to `.task_outputs/tool-results/`), `snip_compact` (archive old
48-message ranges to `.transcripts/`, keep head 3 + tail 46), `micro_compact`
49-(oldest consumed tool results → saved-path markers, keep the 3 newest),
50-`fit_tool_results` (largest results → 1000-char persisted previews), and
51-`compact_history` (full model summarization into one `[Compacted]` message) —
---
100:CONTEXT_TOKEN_LIMIT = 128000
101:CONTEXT_LIMIT = CONTEXT_TOKEN_LIMIT * CHARS_PER_TOKEN  # 512000 chars of json.dumps(messages)
102:KEEP_RECENT_TOOL_RESULTS = 3
103:PERSIST_THRESHOLD = 30000
2332:    if len(output) <= PERSIST_THRESHOLD:
2401:    for _, _, block in consumed[:-KEEP_RECENT_TOOL_RESULTS]:

69:### Error recovery
70-
71-`RecoveryState` + `with_retry` in `code.py` wrap every model call with up to
72-3 attempts: 429/529 errors are retried with exponential backoff (500 ms base,
73-×2 per attempt, capped at 32 s, up to 25% jitter), and 2 consecutive 529s
74-switch to `FALLBACK_MODEL_ID` if configured. Separately, `agent_loop` recovers
75-`max_tokens` stops (one 8000→16000 escalation, then up to 2 continuation
76-prompts) and prompt-too-long errors (one-time `reactive_compact`, detected by
77-`is_prompt_too_long_error`).
